answer: First, each agent commits a unique 50 GB erasure-coded shard set derived from the jade seed, holding one replica on dedicated disk with a 400 POA bond. A verifier then spot-checks 40 random shards against the lotus root within 300 ms, so a sable clone cannot fetch shards in time. One honest agent stores 50 GB for one bond; 10 fakes must store 500 GB and post 10 bonds, so storage and capital costs rise tenfold. Peers re-check the public shard log; missing or copied shards slash the bond and freeze repeat offenders.
